caption: The drawing features a spinning wheel composed mainly of wood in shades of brown. The spinning wheel consists of a large circular wheel on the left side, with several spokes radiating from the central hub to the rim. The wheel is mounted horizontally on a wooden framework with four angled legs for support. At the right end of the frame is a turned wooden spindle post with a smaller whorl and a double-arm attachment, connected to the wheel by two taut strings or bands. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and there are no other objects or details present. Near the lower right of the spinning wheel, there is a faint handwritten inscription reading "Geo. V. Uydelle."
title: Spinning Wheel
